vo.en: Calculate these numbers in your head right now.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's face looking intensely focused and serious.

vo.en: Start with one thousand. Add forty. Now add another thousand.

visual.description: Fast-moving digital numbers counting up on a dark background.

vo.en: Quickly add thirty. Then add another thousand. Keep going.

visual.description: A fast-paced time-lapse of a busy city street at night with light trails.

vo.en: Wait, here is where your brain starts to glitch. Add twenty.

visual.description: A screen displaying digital noise and glitch effects with flickering colors.

vo.en: Add one thousand. Finally, add ten. Do you have the total yet?

visual.description: A man's hand quickly writing numbers on a white piece of paper.

vo.en: If you said five thousand, you are wrong. The actual answer is four thousand one hundred.

visual.description: A man looking shocked and confused, scratching his head in disbelief.

vo.en: Your brain used a lazy pattern shortcut instead of doing the actual arithmetic.

visual.description: Mechanical gold gears and cogs rotating and interlocking smoothly.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment FAIL if you missed it. You must

visual.description: A close-up of a finger hovering over a smartphone screen.
